Name: Salma, Son of Nahshon
Summary: Son of Nahshon and father of Boaz in Judah's genealogy.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 2:11: Son of Nahshon and father of Boaz in Judah's genealogy.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Salma stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
